title: Dify 作例・解説動画
message: 問い合わせを、3つの担当へ。8件の入力と結果を、持ち帰る。
audience: 問い合わせの振り分けや引き継ぎメモを、Dify のワークフロー（DSL）で決めたルールとして持ちたい日本語の読者・運用担当
next_action: 作例ページ（../index.html）で8件の入力・実際のメモ・通った道筋を読み、JSON と workflow.yml を開く

output.orientation: landscape only; no portrait or square composition is authored

authorship.film_code_and_japanese_copy: Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5) wrote index.html, video.css, video.js, storyboard.json and README.md in this folder.
authorship.workflow_and_viewer: Claude Opus 5.5 also wrote workflow.yml, the run.py wrapper and the Japanese viewer page earlier in this case.
authorship.inputs: input/tickets.json (eight fictional tickets) and input/expected.json were written by the Studio Yebisu production side and frozen before execution; not by Opus.
authorship.execution: The production side ran the official graphon 0.7.0 wheel (graphon.dsl.inspect / loads, SlimDslNodeFactory, GraphEngine.run) and the unmodified Dify WorkflowGraphTopology, and recorded outputs/workflow-runs.json and outputs/independent-checks.json. Routes come from value comparisons and memos from template substitution inside the library; no language model produced any memo, route or count.
authorship.screenshots: video/assets/phone.png and desktop.png are byte-for-byte copies of native IAB Chromium captures of the Studio Yebisu viewer page, taken by the production side.

manifest.rule: video.js compares the manifest's eight keys and digests with the same eight values frozen in video.js before fetching anything else.

files.role: actual run record: inputs, memo text, selected route, node path, taken/skipped edge events, node titles, 196 passed checks
independent comparison: route and node path per case, route counts 優先対応/請求窓口/通常窓口, 49 topology pairs; cross-checked, counts compared
frozen fictional inputs; each run input must equal it field by field
Dify DSL; the rule wording (1. 至急、または影響人数100人以上 2. 種類が請求 3. それ以外) and 上から順に判定し、最初に当てはまった分岐だけを通る。 are copied from the route node description; ≥ and '100' are checked in the conditions
pinned upstream: langgenius/dify f77facf (1.17.1), graphon 0.7.0 wheel digest, 292 files
screenshot provenance, sample IDs and pixel size

sources.fetch_rule: video.js fetches the manifest as assets/data-hashes.json and each key as new URL('../' + key, document.baseURI), same origin only. A missing file, a SHA-256 mismatch, a different pinned version, a failed run or independent check, or a record that disagrees with the inputs rejects window.motionReady; there is no embedded fallback.

upstream.license: Dify Open Source License (Apache License 2.0 with additional conditions)

runtime_dependency.name: graphon
runtime_dependency.why: Dify 1.17.1 api/pyproject.toml declares graphon==0.7.0 and api/uv.lock pins this exact wheel

scope.shown: A Studio Yebisu Dify DSL loaded and run headless by the official graphon 0.7.0 DSL runtime for eight fictional tickets; Dify's own WorkflowGraphTopology on the same graph; the Studio Yebisu viewer page that reads the saved record.
not_shown_or_claimed: Dify server, console, API or Docker
importing workflow.yml into the Dify UI, or any original Dify web/ screen or logo
LLM inference, semantic classification or summarisation (routes are value comparisons; memos are template substitution)
sandbox or security guarantees (D07 is one small text example)
continuous screen recording (this is an edited code film)
scope.excluded_from_screen: No fake terminal, log or 'AI 判断' progress; no full hashes; no core API identifiers in the main copy; no automatic-check score as marketing.

design.fonts: Local system fonts only: "Noto Sans JP", "Hiragino Sans", "Yu Gothic", Meiryo, sans-serif; Consolas/Menlo for IDs and the D07 script line. No downloads.
design.continuity: Each ticket is one paper card. Scene 1 shows all eight in a row; the case each later scene uses (D02, D06, D04, D05, D07) grows out of its own slot. The left edge of each card turns the colour of its actual route and keeps it.
design.labels: Diagrams are captioned 説明図; screenshots are captioned 閲覧ページの実画面 and are drawn whole from the verified bytes, scaled only.
persistent: masthead: Dify ワークフローの実行記録から + case IDs on screen; operation rail 入力 → ルール → メモ → 持ち帰る with the current step underlined
footer: Dify DSLの実行記録・無音

scenes.headline: 問い合わせを、3つの担当へ。
scenes.takeaway: Eight fictional tickets go to three owners by rule; the owner names are the first memo line of the actual output.
scenes.enter: Headline 0.1–0.5 s; cards drop in D01→D08 0.35–1.59 s; route boxes 1.1–1.7 s; card edges take route colour 1.6–2.0 s; curves card → route 1.7–2.6 s; caption 2.3 s; operation strip 2.5–2.9 s.

data.routes: first line of cases[].output.text (【担当】…), grouped by output.selected_case_id in if-else order urgent, billing, false

scenes.headline: ルールで、担当のメモへ。
scenes.takeaway: The workflow has seven nodes and eight edges; D02 actually went start → route → billing-note → merge → end and returned a 請求窓口 memo.
scenes.enter: D02 card grows to the memo band 4.0–4.5 s; diagram 4.05–4.45 s; path edges in order 4.6–5.88 s, each node lit as reached; memo card 5.8–6.2 s.

data.edges: union of GraphEdgeTakenEvent / GraphEdgeSkippedEvent across the eight cases (8)
data.path: cases[D02].output.node_path, equal to its GraphEdgeTakenEvent sequence and the independent actual_node_path
data.memo: cases[D02].output.text lines 【担当】, 件名：, 次の対応：

scenes.label: 説明図（layout is Studio Yebisu's, not the Dify editor)

scenes.headline: 請求でも、至急を先に。
scenes.takeaway: D06 is 請求 and 至急; rule 2 also matches, but rules are checked from the top and the first match (優先対応) wins.
scenes.enter: D06 card grows to the input band 8.0–8.5 s; rule rows 8.4–8.95 s; pencil under 請求・至急 8.7–9.2 s; rule 1 lit 8.9–9.2 s; （これも当てはまる） 9.3 s; result card 9.4–9.8 s; rule sentence 9.6–10.0 s.

data.rules: workflow.yml route node desc, copied verbatim

scenes.note: No new inference; the film only shows the recorded output beside the recorded rule order.

scenes.headline: 100人以上は、優先対応へ。
scenes.takeaway: Of the three fields the rule reads, only affected users differ: 99 went to 通常窓口, 100 to 優先対応. A rule boundary, not a quality measurement.
scenes.enter: D04 card grows 12.0–12.5 s with its marker at 99 and its own memo card; number line and 100人以上 12.05–12.45 s; takeaway line 12.6–13.0 s.
scenes.cut: Dip at 14.7–15.3 s: D04 card, marker and memo fade out together by 15.0 s; D05 card, marker and memo fade in together from 15.0 s. No frame shows one case's input beside the other's result.

data.inputs: cases[D04].input, cases[D05].input (issue and urgency equal; users 99 and 100)
data.results: cases[D04|D05].output.text lines 【担当】, 件名：, 種類・緊急度：, 問い合わせ：
data.label: 100人以上 from workflow.yml desc; ≥ and '100' checked in the condition

scenes.label: Number line is 説明図

scenes.headline: 入力は、そのままメモに。
scenes.takeaway: {{ 7 * 7 }} and a <script> line in the input appear in the returned memo as the same text; one small example, not a security proof.
scenes.enter: D07 card grows 18.0–18.5 s; memo card and そのまま arrow 18.5–18.9 s; pencil under the memo's 件名 and 本文 lines 19.0–19.6 s; takeaway 19.3–19.7 s.

data.result: cases[D07].output.text lines 件名：… and the body's first line; the record contains no '49'

scenes.note: The strings are painted as canvas text; nothing is run, evaluated or inserted as HTML.

scenes.headline: 8件の入力と結果を、持ち帰る。
scenes.takeaway: 3 優先対応 / 1 請求窓口 / 4 通常窓口 from the eight actual outputs; workflow.yml and workflow-runs.json open from the case page; actual viewer screens D02 and D05 as a supplement.

data.files: workflow.yml and outputs/workflow-runs.json (case count from the record)

contract.canvas: getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true }); backing store equals renderConfig width × height; layout authored at 1280×720 and scaled
contract.seek: window.seek(seconds) clamps to 0..28 and returns a Promise that resolves after the requested frame is drawn from absolute time; no frame depends on earlier frames, wall clock or randomness
contract.ready: window.motionReady resolves after the manifest and eight files match SHA-256, the pinned source/version, the run checks and the independent checks validate, both screenshots decode at their recorded size and local fonts are loaded; otherwise it rejects and the page shows the reason
contract.export_mode: window.__MOTION_RENDER__ === true: editor chrome hidden, canvas only at exact size, no requestAnimationFrame preview
contract.preview: Starts paused at 0, no autoplay. #play toggles 再生/一時停止 (aria-pressed); #reset returns to 0; #timeline (range 0–28 step 0.1) and #time (number 0–28 step 0.1; typing and Enter seek); #time-counter shows the current time after each seek; #editor[data-state] is loading, ready or error
